neighbours.label: the word ' venom' (venom, venomous, antivenom)
neighbours.notes: Label chosen by Twitch chat vote (default option, no votes cast). Exploration suggests the pole is broader at the spelling level: other multi-token words starting with 'ven/Ven' also fire (Venus, Venice, Venezuela, venison, French 'venus'), while single-token venue/vent/vendor/vending/revenge stay near 0. Near misses keep the snake/sting/poison topic and drop only the word venom.
